crossRefs.note: She will be a place for the spreading of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have spoken it,’ says the Lord Yahweh.…

translations.web: Your borders are in the heart of the seas. Your builders have perfected your beauty.
translations.bsb: Your borders are in the heart of the seas; your builders perfected your beauty.
translations.kjv: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.
translations.asv: Thy borders are in the heart of the seas; thy builders have perfected thy beauty.
